$comment: design §7.3's structural rules, plus §10.4's ledger-only rule, as data. `runlib/placement.py` applies them in this order and refuses by the row's `code`. Every row names the design sentence it comes from, and `placement.fidelity_problems` holds the list against the copied and cited sentences in that module's suite.

operations.$comment: §7.3's typed operations. `merge` is executed as deletes plus one edit and is labelled merge for the global rule (§13.1), so the label is part of the data rather than a reader's inference.
operations.$comment_global: the always-loaded global file and its Korean counterpart: §13.1's gate compares `claude/CLAUDE.md`, and the Korean file is the same surface in the other language, so a growth there is the same change. `codex/AGENTS.md` is not listed: it is a generated projection and no proposal may edit it by hand (AGENTS.md §4).

rules.design: Global-file operations other than delete and merge are rejected
rules.applies_to: an operation whose target is the always-loaded global file
rules.requires: the operation's type is one of operations.global_allowed

rules.design: an incubate without observation and expiry
rules.applies_to: a proposal whose disposition is incubate
rules.requires: the proposal carries an expected observation and an expiry

rules.applies_to: a proposal whose disposition is keep or drop

rules.design: a disposition the promotion eligibility or §7.2 does not allow
rules.requires: the (kind, diagnosis, disposition) triple is a row of tables/allowed_pairs.json, and its condition holds

rules.$comment: the same code, because §7.2 and the promotion bar are one sentence in the design: a disposition neither allows is the same refusal. The row is separate so the reason says which of the two closed it.
rules.design: a disposition the promotion eligibility or §7.2 does not allow
rules.applies_to: a proposal for a candidate below the promotion bar
rules.requires: the disposition is one of incubate, keep, drop

rules.design: a `reduce` or `merge` touching a unit with an active `keep` record unless the proposal names the record
rules.applies_to: a reduce disposition, or a merge operation, touching a unit with an active keep record
rules.requires: the proposal names that keep record

rules.$comment: design §10.4, carried here because it is a structural property of the proposal and not of its placement: the plan's done-when 6.
rules.design: Keep/incubate/drop proposals carry no library operations and `requires_test == false`
rules.applies_to: a proposal whose disposition is keep, incubate or drop
rules.requires: the proposal carries no library operation and its requires_test is false
